notes: All clips cut from broadcaster uploads at 480p via yt-dlp (android player client; the default client returned HTTP 403 on this machine). Every clip was checked in contact sheets, a 2 fps zoom sheet and one full-size proof frame. No audio was listened to, so 'quote' is left empty throughout; check before relying on a window being free of speech.

subjects.subject: Feb 10 Tumbler Ridge, BC mass shooting (vigils only)

clips.name: fire-tumbler-vigil-crowd-dusk
clips.shows: wide shot at dusk, a crowd of a few hundred in winter coats stands in a snowy square in front of a timber community building with string lights, backs mostly to camera
clips.onScreenText: Hundreds attend candlelight vigil as Tumbler Ridge community honours victims / Breaking News · B.C. Mass Shooting / CBC NN LIVE
clips.readsSilent: the lower third names the town and the mass shooting; the crowd and the snow give the scale
clips.caveats: shooting was Feb 10; vigil footage uploaded Feb 12. CBC corner bug animates (NEWS / NETWORK / CBC NN LIVE) during the window.

clips.name: fire-tumbler-vigil-crowd-backs

clips.readsSilent: grief read from bodies, no faces, chyron carries the event
clips.caveats: shooting was Feb 10; vigil footage uploaded Feb 12

subjects.subject: Apr 23 to 29 central and southern US storm week; EF4 tornado at Vance AFB, Enid, Oklahoma

clips.name: fire-enid-sky5-subdivision-wide
clips.shows: helicopter wide shot over a rural subdivision south of Enid: a grid of lots with every house reduced to slab and splinters, debris across the fields, a highway at the edge of frame
clips.onScreenText: HAPPENING NOW IN ENID / SKY 5 SURVEYS OKLAHOMA TORNADO DAMAGE / BREAKING NEWS / KOCO 5
clips.readsSilent: the debris field from the air is the whole story; chyron names Oklahoma and tornado

clips.onScreenText: HAPPENING NOW IN ENID / SKY 5 SURVEYS OKLAHOMA TORNADO DAMAGE / BREAKING NEWS / KOCO 5
clips.readsSilent: scale from the cars; the camera drift keeps it alive

clips.readsSilent: the funnel needs no caption; the live bug and radar inset date it as broadcast
